category_title: Social fourth-grade student with learning disabilities who frequently seeks teacher assistance
minimal_context: Julia is working independently on an expository writing task about her favorite holiday using a graphic organizer.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have thirty minutes of writing time today. The prompt is: Everyone has a favorite holiday. Think about your favorite holiday and explain how you celebrate it. Please work independently on your first draft.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand immediately) I don't know what to do. I can't get started on my writing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just pick a holiday you like and write down a few sentences about it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I wrote: 'Everybody has a favorite holiday . Mine is easter. I like to paint the eggs . I like to find the egg’s to.' But I don't know what else to write.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying. Look at your paper and add some more details about painting the eggs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand again, complaining) I added 'Once I painted A egg orange and blue whitch is the gator colors', but I can't move further! This is too hard and I need you to come help me right now.

task.content: Everyone has a favorite holiday. Think about your favorite holiday and explain how you celebrate it.
task.learning_goal: analyze the prompt, plan their writing using graphic organizers, write a first draft, and revise their writing based on feedback

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: to move further after she get started on planning or writing a first paragraph
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: her hand was often the first one to go up for help, complaining
related_quotes: inevitably needed Mrs. Lane’s help to move further
her hand was often the first one to go up for help
